name: 08 Marcus — Written + Audio Fulfillment — INACTIVE DRAFT

parameters.content:
# NEW 08 MARCUS — INACTIVE BUILD DRAFT
24h standard / +$12.77 = 12h. Audio uses the same order deadline.

Guard is OFF. Production backend adapters + credentials + Marcus voice + private PDF storage remain unwired. No existing workflow was modified.

Each edition supplies its theme and ordered free/paid positions. No stage assumes six cards.

Main PDF report → queue written delivery → audio chain. Late audio event resumes that chain. Delivery jobs run separately in this SAME workflow.
